place.title: Amber, green marble and slow smoke
place.body: GOIA is a huqqa lounge in Kehl, a few tram stops from Strasbourg. Light glows through fluted glass, the tables are green marble, and the evening moves at the pace of the shisha.

ambiance.title: Three textures, one evening
ambiance.amber: Behind fluted glass, a warm light that tints the whole room.
ambiance.marble: Green marble tables for shishas, plates and glasses.
ambiance.smoke: Smoke curls slowly up past the glowing arches.

table.title: What lands on the marble
table.shisha: Prepared to order. Current flavours are on the menu.
table.sweets: Like this speculoos cheesecake on a white plate.
table.glass: Passion fruit, dried citrus, bright colours.
